(in-package :game-2048)

(defun slide-row (row)
  "Slide ROW toward its first element, returning the row and merge score."
  (let* ((tiles (remove 0 row))
         (result '())
         (score 0))
    (loop while tiles do
      (let ((tile (pop tiles)))
        (if (and tiles (= tile (first tiles)))
            (let ((merged (* 2 tile)))
              (pop tiles)
              (push merged result)
              (incf score merged))
            (push tile result))))

(in-package :game-2048)

(defun slide-row (row)
  "Slide ROW toward its first element, returning the row and merge score."
  (let* ((tiles (remove 0 row))
         (result '())
         (score 0))
    (loop while tiles do
      (let ((tile (pop tiles)))
        (if (and tiles (= tile (first tiles)))
            (let ((merged (* 2 tile)))
              (pop tiles)
              (push merged result)
              (incf score merged))
            (push tile result))))
    (let ((merged-row (nreverse result)))
      (values (nconc merged-row
                     (make-list (- 4 (length merged-row)) :initial-element 0))
              score))))

(defun %valid-board-p (board)
  (and (arrayp board) (equal (array-dimensions board) '(4 4))))

(defun move (board direction)
  (unless (%valid-board-p board)
    (error "Expected a 4 by 4 board, got ~S" board))
  (unless (member direction '(:left :right :up :down))
    (error "Invalid direction: ~S" direction))
  (let ((result (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0))
        (score 0))
    (dotimes (line 4)
      (let ((row (loop for offset below 4
                       collect (if (member direction '(:left :right))
                                   (aref board line
                                         (if (eq direction :left) offset (- 3 offset)))
                                   (aref board
                                         (if (eq direction :up) offset (- 3 offset))
                                         line)))))
        (multiple-value-bind (slid gained) (slide-row row)
          (incf score gained)
          (dotimes (offset 4)
            (if (member direction '(:left :right))
                (setf (aref result line
                            (if (eq direction :left) offset (- 3 offset)))
                      (nth offset slid))
                (setf (aref result (if (eq direction :up) offset (- 3 offset)) line)
                      (nth offset slid)))))))
    (values result score (not (equalp board result)))))

(defun spawn-tile (board random-state)
  (unless (%valid-board-p board)
    (error "Expected a 4 by 4 board, got ~S" board))
  (let ((empty '())
        (result (make-array '(4 4))))
    (dotimes (row 4)
      (dotimes (column 4)
        (when (zerop (aref board row column))
          (push (cons row column) empty))
        (setf (aref result row column) (aref board row column))))
    (when (null empty)
      (error "Cannot spawn a tile on a full board"))
    (let* ((cell (nth (random (length empty) random-state) empty))
           (value (if (< (random 10 random-state) 9) 2 4)))
      (setf (aref result (car cell) (cdr cell)) value))
    result))

(defun won-p (board)
  (dotimes (row 4 nil)
    (dotimes (column 4)
      (when (= (aref board row column) 2048)
        (return-from won-p t)))))

(defun game-over-p (board)
  (loop for direction in '(:left :right :up :down)
        always (not (nth-value 2 (move board direction)))))

(defun %print-board (board score output)
  (format output "Score: ~D~%" score)
  (dotimes (row 4)
    (format output "|~{~6A|~}~%"
            (loop for column below 4
                  for value = (aref board row column)
                  collect (if (zerop value) "" value))))
  (finish-output output))

(defun play (&key (input *standard-input*) (output *standard-output*)
                  (random-state (make-random-state t)))
  (let ((board (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0))
        (score 0)
        (announced-win nil))
    (setf board (spawn-tile board random-state)
          board (spawn-tile board random-state))
    (%print-board board score output)
    (loop
      (when (game-over-p board)
        (format output "Game over!~%")
        (return))
      (let ((line (read-line input nil nil)))
        (when (null line) (return))
        (let* ((key (string-downcase (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Return) line)))
               (direction (cdr (assoc key '(("w" . :up) ("a" . :left)
                                             ("s" . :down) ("d" . :right))
                                         :test #'string=))))
          (cond
            ((string= key "q") (return))
            (direction
             (multiple-value-bind (moved gained changed) (move board direction)
               (when changed
                 (setf board (spawn-tile moved random-state))
                 (incf score gained))
               (when (and (not announced-win) (won-p board))
                 (setf announced-win t)
                 (format output "You won!~%"))))
            (t (format output "Invalid key.~%")))
          (%print-board board score output))))))
